title: 第1650章 神通与奇珍第1649章 身死道消
content_zh:
张皓旸在处理完慕容家的事情之后并未急于奔赴玄宸星域剑墟擎天峰，寻柳寒山清算因果。
此刻他的修为只有星君巅峰，虽经死战淬炼，战力远超同阶，可越境杀敌。但是柳寒山乃是坐镇四重天万古的老牌星帝巅峰强者，底蕴深厚、道藏无数、手段莫测。
以他当前实力，对战普通星帝中期尚可一战、甚至逆势斩杀，就像慕容渊，如果对上星帝后期甚至是星帝巅峰，大概率会身受重创。纵使身怀大空间术、太虚遁光，可瞬息遁走、保全性命，却无法达成彻底斩除祸首、肃清四重天的初衷。
此战过后，他对大道奥义、神通法则皆有全新感悟，又从慕容渊神魂记忆、慕容家宝库之中，收获两门顶尖神通与海量珍稀天材地宝，正是突破修为、淬炼神通的最佳时机。
他在慕容家找了一间修炼密室，布下几层空间禁制，隔绝外界的窥探与干扰。随后，他的身形一闪，就进入混沌造化空间。
太初神木苍翠参天，灵气氤氲、道韵流淌。他与宁馨儿、青枝、红蕊三女将具体情况细说，三女听后，由于初来此地，她们还是想去游历一下沧澜城镇。
如今沧澜剧变，慕容家覆灭震慑全境，无人敢肆意生事，更无人敢招惹他身边之人，他坦然应允，任由三女安心游历。
送走宁馨儿三女，他转身踏入混沌塔五层，闭关苦修，参悟神通，冲击境界！
张皓旸盘膝坐于混沌塔五层，双目闭合，心神彻底沉入无垠神魂识海。此番所得机缘无数，其中最珍贵、最逆天的便是星辰大道顶级神通《万星归墟诀》与上古至尊神通《大光阴诸天术》，他摒除杂念，神魂尽数铺开，开始沉浸式推演、淬炼、圆满两大无上神通。
星辰绝学·万星归墟诀，乃是统御诸天星辰大道的顶级神通，品级远超寻常星辰道法。
此前张皓旸仅领悟部分星辰道纹，只能粗浅引动星力攻伐，威力有限。此番得完整传承，他神魂游走诸天星道脉络，以元神牵引漫天星辉，一遍遍推演功法本源，拆解星辰聚散、星河生灭、星力吞噬的核心奥义。
他每一次推演，周身便有亿万星砂流转盘旋，识海之中星辰道纹不断亮起、重组、凝练，破碎的残缺道印尽数补全，晦涩的功法节点一一贯通。
初练之时，星力躁动暴乱、难以掌控，可随着他千万次法门运转、元神浸润打磨，狂暴的星辰之力渐渐温顺如臂使指，与自身道基、经脉完美契合。从引星攻伐，到聚星囚天，再到凝墟寂灭，层层递进、步步圆满。
历经百次时空推演，此术彻底大成圆满，可执掌亿万星河、操控诸天星力。核心三式杀招极尽霸道，威力滔天：
第一式星落碎穹，引九天恒星真火、陨星之力凝聚万丈巨型星矛，矛身裹挟星辰毁灭道韵，坠落之时可直接砸裂虚空壁垒，粉碎万里山河，硬生生崩碎星帝境强者的道体护盾；
第二式万星囚天，布亿万星砂凝成九转星狱牢笼，层层星链锁死大道、封禁灵机、禁锢神魂，任凭对手身法通天、遁术无双，一旦入笼便寸步难行、无路可逃；
第三式归墟寂灭，收拢漫天星辰之力化作漆黑无垠的归墟黑洞，可吞噬一切术法、兵刃、神魂本源，硬生生磨灭强敌万古道韵与修为根基。
功法圆满刹那，张皓旸周身常驻无尽星辰道域，星力环绕周身、生生不息、无有枯竭。近身交战，星域震荡便可震碎帝阶神通、崩裂敌手肉身；远程攻伐，亿万星河倾覆而下，覆天盖地、无可匹敌，真正做到同境碾压、跨境杀伐。
参悟完星辰大道，张皓旸神魂一转，尽数投向整场机缘最珍贵的至宝—万古岁月甲片。
此甲片藏于慕容家宝库最幽暗角落，蒙尘万古、无人问津，却是整座宝库最无上的至宝。它乃是上古光阴道祖本命至宝残片，承载亿万年光阴沉淀，封存着一套完整无缺的顶级时间至尊秘术《大光阴诸天术》。慕容渊不修时间大道，眼界浅薄、道心狭隘，纵使坐拥逆天至宝，也只当寻常废碎古物，视而不见、弃之不理。

可张皓旸早已深耕时间秘法，神魂对光阴道韵极为敏锐。当日踏入宝库刹那，他便捕捉到一缕微弱却至高无上的时序气息，穿透层层尘封，锁定这枚古朴甲片。
当他指尖轻触甲身，他身上散发色时间法则道韵，立即没入甲片之上，沉寂亿万年的光阴至宝瞬间复苏，浩瀚苍茫的光阴道韵如天河倒灌，轰然涌入识海，无数晦涩玄妙、源自上古道祖的时间道则图谱、时序运转奥义、光阴杀伐法门，尽数烙印在他的神魂本源之中。
此刻闭关苦修，便是彻底炼化、融会贯通、圆满神通的关键时刻。张皓旸凝神静气，以元神牵引甲片道韵，一遍遍冲刷自身时间道基，拆解每一道时序奥义，磨合每一招光阴法门。过往他掌握的粗浅时间术法，仅能瞬息定格片刻光阴，力道微弱、时长极短，对战高阶帝者仅能聊作牵制，毫无决胜之力，属于锦上添花的小术。
而今炼化完整《大光阴诸天术》，他的时间造诣彻底脱胎换骨，真正执掌一方时序乾坤，五大逆天奥义尽数圆满成型，招招制衡战局、可逆战局、可斩帝尊：
岁月静止，可强行定格千里天地时序，禁锢星帝巅峰强者足足三息之久，三息之内，天地静止、万物凝滞，对手身形、神通、道力、神魂尽数封困，沦为砧板鱼肉、任人宰割；
光阴逆流，可逆转五丈光阴长河，回溯自身肉身伤势、修复道基裂痕、填补本源损耗，哪怕脏腑崩碎、道基断裂、身受致命重创，亦可刹那复原、满血再战；
时序断层，撕裂万古时间长河，制造数息绝对时间真空，隔绝一切神通术法流转，封禁对手所有大道之力，令其战力瞬间归零、无招可出；
未来预判，窥探十息之内战局所有变数，洞悉对手杀招、陷阱、偷袭轨迹，提前规避一切绝杀危机，料敌先机、立于不败之地；岁月剥蚀，最为歹毒霸道、无解杀伐，催动亿万年光阴沉淀之力，层层剥蚀对手道基、磨灭万古修为、老化神魂本源，哪怕是坐拥无尽底蕴的老牌星帝巅峰，也会被瞬间掏空根基、道体枯萎、修为大跌。

content_en:
After Zhang Haoyang finished handling the affairs of the Murong family, he did not rush to the Sword Ruins Qingtian Peak in Xuanchen Star Region to find Liu Hanshan to settle the cause and effect.
At this moment, his cultivation level is only at the peak of Xingjun. Although he has been tempered by deadly battles, his combat power is far higher than that of the same level, and he can kill enemies across borders. But Liu Hanshan is a veteran star emperor who has been at the peak of the fourth heaven for eternity. He has a profound foundation, countless hidden secrets, and unpredictable methods.
With his current strength, he can still fight against an ordinary Star Emperor in the middle stage, or even kill him against the odds. Just like Murong Yuan, if he fights against a Star Emperor in the late stage or even the peak Star Emperor, there is a high probability that he will be seriously injured. Even though he possesses the Great Space Technique and Taixu Escape Light, he can escape instantly and save his life, but he cannot achieve the original intention of completely killing the culprit and purging the fourth heaven.
After this battle, he gained a new understanding of the secrets of the avenue and the laws of supernatural powers. From the memory of Murong Yuan's soul and the treasure house of the Murong family, he gained two top magical powers and a massive amount of rare heavenly materials and earthly treasures. It was the best time to break through his cultivation and refine his magical powers.
He found a secret practice room in Murong's house and set up several layers of space restrictions to isolate him from outside prying eyes and interference. Then, his figure flashed and entered the chaotic creation space.
In the early days, the sacred trees were green and towering, filled with spiritual energy and flowing Taoism. He and the three girls Ning Xiner, Qingzhi, and Hongrui explained the specific situation in detail. After hearing this, the three girls decided that since they were new to this place, they still wanted to visit Canglan Town.
Nowadays, Canglan has undergone drastic changes, and the destruction of the Murong family has shocked the entire territory. No one dares to cause trouble, and no one dares to provoke the people around him. He calmly agreed and allowed the three daughters to travel in peace.
After sending Ning Xiner and his three daughters away, he turned around and stepped into the fifth floor of the Chaos Tower, where he practiced hard in seclusion, comprehended magical powers, and hit the realm!
Zhang Haoyang sat cross-legged on the fifth floor of the Chaos Tower, his eyes closed, and his mind completely sank into the boundless sea of ​​soul consciousness. There were countless opportunities gained during this time, among which the most precious and heaven-defying ones were the top magical power of the Avenue of Stars, "The Return of Ten Thousand Stars to the Ruins," and the ancient supreme magical power, "The Technique of the Heavens of Great Time." He got rid of distracting thoughts, spread all his soul, and began to immersively deduce, refine, and perfect the two supreme magical powers.
The Secret Art of the Stars: Return of Ten Thousand Stars to the Ruins is a top-notch magical power that governs the avenues of stars in the heavens, and its level far exceeds ordinary star Taoism.
Previously, Zhang Haoyang had only comprehended part of the star pattern, and could only briefly mobilize the star power to attack, with limited power. With this complete inheritance, his soul traveled through the star paths of the sky, using his soul to draw the starry sky, deducing the origin of the technique over and over again, and unraveling the core secrets of the gathering and dispersing of stars, the birth and death of galaxies, and the devouring of star power.
Every time he performs a deduction, there are billions of star sand flowing and circling around him. The star patterns in the sea of ​​​​consciousness continue to light up, reorganize, and condense. All the broken and incomplete seals are completed, and the obscure Kung Fu nodes are connected one by one.
When he first started practicing, the star power was turbulent and difficult to control. However, as he performed thousands of times and the soul was soaked and polished, the violent star power gradually became as docile as an arm and a finger, perfectly matching his own Taoist base and meridians. From attracting stars to attack, to gathering stars to imprison the sky, to condensing ruins to be destroyed, it is progressing step by step, reaching perfection step by step.
After hundreds of time and space deductions, this technique has been completely perfected and can control billions of galaxies and control the star power of the heavens. The three core killing moves are extremely domineering and powerful:
The first type of star falls to shatter the sky, attracting the true fire of nine stars and the power of falling stars to condense the giant star spear. The spear body wraps up the stars and destroys the Tao Yun. When it falls, it can directly smash the void barrier, shatter thousands of miles of mountains and rivers, and forcibly break the Tao body shield of the strong Star Emperor realm;
The second style of Ten Thousand Stars Imprisoning the Sky is to spread hundreds of millions of star sand to form a nine-turn star prison cage. Layers of star chains lock the avenue, seal the inspiration, and imprison the soul. No matter how powerful the opponent's body is, and his escape skills are unparalleled, once he is trapped in the cage, he will be unable to move and have no way to escape;
The third form of Guixu Nirvana gathers the power of the stars in the sky and turns it into a pitch-black and boundless Guixu black hole, which can swallow up all spells, weapons, and spiritual souls, and forcibly destroy the powerful enemy's eternal Taoist charm and cultivation foundation.
The moment the skill was completed, Zhang Haoyang was stationed in the realm of endless stars all over his body, and his star powerSurrounding the body, it is endless and endless. In close combat, the shock of the star field can shatter the emperor's supernatural powers and shatter the opponent's physical body; in long-range attacks, billions of galaxies can fall down, covering the sky and the earth, and being unrivaled, truly crushing the same territory and killing across borders.
After comprehending the Avenue of Stars, Zhang Haoyang's soul turned and turned towards the most precious treasure in the whole game - the Eternal Age Armor.
This piece of armor is hidden in the darkest corner of the Murong family's treasure house. It has been covered in dust forever and no one cares about it, but it is the most supreme treasure in the entire treasure house. It is a fragment of the natal treasure of the ancient light and vagina ancestor. It carries the accumulation of hundreds of millions of years and seals a complete set of top-level supreme secrets of time, "The Art of the Heavens of Great Time". Murong Yuan did not practice the Great Way of Time, he had a shallow vision and a narrow mind. Even if he was sitting on a heaven-defying treasure, he would just treat it as ordinary scraps and ancient things, turning a blind eye and discarding them.
But Zhang Haoyang has already deeply cultivated the secret method of time, and his soul is extremely sensitive to the rhythm of light and vagina. The moment he stepped into the treasure house that day, he caught a faint but supreme breath of time, penetrated the layers of dust, and locked onto this ancient piece of armor.
When his fingertips lightly touched the body of the armor, the colored rhythm of the law of time emitted from his body and immediately submerged into the armor. The treasure of time that had been dormant for hundreds of millions of years was instantly revived. The vast rhythm of light and vagina poured into the sea of ​​consciousness like the Milky Way. Countless obscure and mysterious diagrams of the law of time, the secrets of time sequence operation, and the method of time killing were all imprinted on the origin of his soul.
This moment of retreat and hard training is the critical moment for complete refining, integration, and perfecting of magical powers. Zhang Haoyang concentrated his mind and used his soul to guide the Tao Yun of the armor piece, washing his own time Tao foundation over and over again, dismantling every secret of time sequence, and honing every move of time. The superficial time spells he had mastered in the past could only freeze time for a moment. Their power was weak and their duration was extremely short. Against high-level emperors, they could only be used as a containment and had no decisive power. They were just icing on the cake.
Now that he has completely refined "The Technique of the Heavens of Great Time", his time attainments have been completely transformed, and he is truly in charge of the time sequence of the universe. The five heaven-defying mysteries have been fully formed, and he can control and balance the battle situation, reverse the battle situation, and kill the emperor:
When the years stand still, it can forcibly freeze the time sequence of the heaven and earth thousands of miles away, and imprison the strongest star emperor for three breaths. Within three breaths, the heaven and earth stand still, all things are stagnant, and the opponent's body shape, magical power, Tao power, and soul are all trapped, and he is reduced to a chopping block and can be slaughtered by others;
The reverse flow of time can reverse the long river of time, trace back the physical injuries, repair the cracks in the foundation, and make up for the original loss. Even if the internal organs are shattered, the foundation is broken, and the body is fatally injured, it can be recovered in an instant and full of blood to fight again;
The time sequence fault tears apart the eternal river of time, creates an absolute time vacuum of several breaths, cuts off the flow of all magical powers, and blocks all the power of the opponent's avenue, causing his combat power to instantly return to zero, leaving him with no moves to make;
Predict the future, spy on all the variables of the civil war situation in ten breaths, understand the opponent's killer moves, traps, and sneak attack trajectories, avoid all critical crises in advance, predict the enemy's opportunities, and remain invincible; the erosion of time will make the most vicious and domineering, inextricable killing , stimulating the power accumulated over hundreds of millions of years, eroding the opponent's Dao foundation layer by layer, erasing eternal cultivation, and aging the origin of the soul. Even the peak of the veteran star emperor with endless heritage will have his foundation hollowed out in an instant, his Dao body will wither, and his cultivation will plummet.
